---
title: "Reporte BIOSZEN"
output:
  html_document: default
  pdf_document: default
params:
  plots: NULL
  norm: NULL
  sig: NULL
  metadata: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

metadata_fun <- if (exists(".bioszen_metadata", mode = "function", inherits = TRUE)) {
  get(".bioszen_metadata", mode = "function", inherits = TRUE)
} else {
  tryCatch(
    {
      if (requireNamespace("BIOSZEN", quietly = TRUE)) {
        getFromNamespace(".bioszen_metadata", "BIOSZEN")
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    },
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

software_metadata <- if (is.function(metadata_fun)) {
  tryCatch(metadata_fun(), error = function(e) NULL)
} else {
  NULL
}

if (is.null(software_metadata)) {
  report_path <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), error = function(e) "")
  description_candidates <- unique(c(
    file.path(dirname(report_path), "..", "..", "..", "DESCRIPTION"),
    file.path(getwd(), "DESCRIPTION"),
    file.path(getwd(), "..", "DESCRIPTION")
  ))
  description_path <- description_candidates[file.exists(description_candidates)][1]
  description_meta <- if (!is.na(description_path)) {
    tryCatch(as.list(read.dcf(description_path)[1, , drop = TRUE]), error = function(e) list())
  } else {
    list()
  }
  description_field <- function(name, default = "") {
    value <- description_meta[[name]]
    if (is.null(value) || !length(value) || is.na(value[[1]]) || !nzchar(value[[1]])) {
      default
    } else {
      as.character(value[[1]])
    }
  }
  rrid <- description_field("Config/BIOSZEN/RRID")
  if (nzchar(rrid) && !grepl("^RRID:", rrid, ignore.case = TRUE)) rrid <- paste0("RRID:", rrid)
  if (length(description_meta)) {
    software_metadata <- list(
      title = "BIOSZEN",
      version = description_field("Version"),
      rrid = rrid,
      rrid_resolver = description_field("Config/BIOSZEN/RRIDResolver"),
      latest_archived_version = description_field("Config/BIOSZEN/LatestArchivedVersion"),
      latest_archived_doi = description_field("Config/BIOSZEN/LatestArchivedDOI")
    )
  }
}
```

## Procedencia del software

```{r software-provenance}
if (!is.null(software_metadata)) {
  methods_statement <- sprintf(
    "Data analysis and visualization were performed with %s v%s (%s; Zenodo DOI: %s).",
    software_metadata$title,
    software_metadata$latest_archived_version,
    software_metadata$rrid,
    software_metadata$latest_archived_doi
  )
  knitr::kable(data.frame(
    Campo = c(
      "Software", "Versión", "RRID", "Resolutor RRID",
      "Versión archivada", "DOI de la versión archivada", "Cita para Métodos"
    ),
    Valor = c(
      software_metadata$title, software_metadata$version, software_metadata$rrid,
      software_metadata$rrid_resolver, software_metadata$latest_archived_version,
      software_metadata$latest_archived_doi, methods_statement
    ),
    check.names = FALSE
  ))
}
```
